items.author: xiaoxiaodong
items.text:
GPT-image2.5 API 还是这么喜欢生成透明度图片哦

知道有个参数可以关闭， 我要去操作下：

可以。GPT Image 2.5 API 可以关闭透明背景生成，只需要把 background 参数设置为 "opaque"。

例如：
```
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

result = client.images.generate(
model="gpt-image-2.5-sunburst",
prompt="一只坐在草地上的猫",
size="1024x1024",
quality="medium",
background="opaque",   # 强制非透明背景
output_format="png"
)
```
items.title: GPT Image 2.5：用 background="opaque" 关掉默认透明底
items.summary: 作者指出 GPT-image2.5 API 很爱出透明图；可用 background 设为 "opaque" 强制非透明背景，并给出 Python 示例（模型名 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst、png 输出等）。
items.recommend_reason: 一条可复制的 API 参数技巧，立刻解决「图总是透明」的踩坑。

items.text:
Prompt ↓

Create a finished experimental editorial poster, 9:16, flat artwork with a thin cream paper edge. Ordered CMYK halftone photography, milky defocused white type, hot yellow-to-red print field.

One high-contrast photographic subject and the colored background are rebuilt from regular CMYK circular halftone dots: angled rows, visible rosettes, subtle cyan and magenta registration fringes. Near-black shadows and cream highlights keep the photo readable. Ordered print screening, not random grain.

One oversized title in bold grotesk, milky white, on a separate smooth layer with soft Gaussian blur and a broad airbrushed halo. No speckle or distress on the white letters. Small supporting copy and a tiny metadata line in razor-sharp black. The subject's shape guides where the title words sit.

Title: "[MAIN_TEXT]"
Supporting copy: "[SECONDARY_TEXT]"
Metadata: "[META_TEXT]"
Subject: [ONE BOLD PHOTOGRAPHIC FORM + LIGHT]
Layout: [HOW THE SUBJECT SPLITS OR CARRIES THE TITLE]

No extra text, no logos, no watermark, no random film grain, no vintage yellowing, no distressed or outlined white title, no mockup perspective.
items.title: CMYK 半色调实验海报提示词：奶油纸边、乳白模糊大标题与锐利黑字层级

items.author: TheTuringPost
items.name: Turing Post
items.text:
AI agents can write working MongoDB code. But they still make mistakes in how they structure data or choose indexes.

That’s why @MongoDB introduced Agent Skills to give them more specific decision guidance.

→ The idea:
Agents get MongoDB patterns they can apply while writing code, so you don’t have to repeat the same rules in every prompt.

Here’s what’s included:

- Guidance on schema design, indexing, and queries to avoid mistakes

- Database access through the MongoDB MCP Server

- Plugins that bring both together

You can get started in Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code. The article includes installation commands + links to setup instructions.

You can also create your own skills for team conventions and recurring workflows, so agents have your project’s rules to work from.

If you use AI agents to write MongoDB code, this is a helpful starting point to add context and avoid common mistakes.

For setup steps and an overview of how it works, check out the full article → https://t.co/9MENytA8bi
items.title: MongoDB Agent Skills：给代理 schema/索引/查询决策指引，可接 Claude Code 与 Cursor
items.summary: The Turing Post 介绍 MongoDB 推出的 Agent Skills：在写库代码时注入 schema 设计、索引与查询模式，经 MCP Server 访问数据库，并在 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、VS Code 安装；也可自建团队约定 skill，减少每条提示词重复规则。
items.recommend_reason: 把「代理会写能跑的 Mongo 代码但仍选错索引」落到可安装的技能包，工程向可跟进。

items.author: TheTuringPost
items.name: Turing Post
items.text:
A very interesting paper on long-term multimodal agent memory ↓

@MemoraX_AI introduced open-source GraphMemix. It reframes long-term memory retrieval from ranking individual records to building a query-aware "evidence forest."

Since it's a graph, each memory is a node.
An edge links two memories when each adds context to the other.

→ The system's core question is: does this memory add something useful beyond what we already found?

Here’s how it works:

1. After a question arrives, GraphMemix builds a graph around relevant memories.

2. It checks individual memories and their connections, then selects a set that supports the answer together.

This helps recover useful details that similarity search often misses, reducing redundant context as well.

Across 4 multimodal memory benchmarks, average judge-rated accuracy reached:

• 61.55% with Qwen3-VL-8B, +11.75 points over the strongest baseline on average.
• 67.42% with Gemma 4 12B, showing gains with another model too.

In one example, GraphMemix had to identify two dogs described as smart and quick to learn. It connected clues that similarity search missed and correctly identified both: Lumi the Maltese and Coco the Toy Poodle.

So a memory that looks unimportant alone can become essential when connected to another.
items.title: GraphMemix：长时多模态记忆从「单条排序」改为构建查询感知证据森林
items.summary: MemoraX 开源 GraphMemix：记忆为图节点，互为上下文则连边；检索时围绕问题建图，判断新记忆是否相对已选集合带来增量，组成共同支撑答案的证据集。四项多模态记忆基准上，Qwen3-VL-8B 均分约 61.55%（较最强基线 +11.75），Gemma 4 12B 约 67.42%；示例里靠关联线索识别两只狗，而纯相似度检索会漏。
items.recommend_reason: 长时记忆从相似度 Top-K 升级到「证据森林」，论文+开源且有可感知的基准增益。

items.author: fchollet
items.name: François Chollet
items.text:
The purpose of the AI industry should be to produce tools that, in the human hand, will improve human prosperity and welfare.

It should not be to create a "successor species" to the human race. Entertaining such a thought makes you, de facto, the enemy of all present and future humans.
items.title: Chollet：AI 产业目标应是人手中的繁荣工具，而非打造人类「继任物种」
items.summary: François Chollet 写道：AI 产业的目的应是造出在人手中能提升人类繁荣与福祉的工具，而不是创造人类的「继任物种」；抱持后者等于与所有现世及未来人类为敌。
items.recommend_reason: Chollet 对产业目的论的强硬划线，适合对照「继任物种」叙事。

items.author: GoSailGlobal
items.text:
模型从空手开局，在《我的世界》里一路打到末影龙，8 分 43 秒通关

零死亡，满血走出末地传送门

minecraft-agent，一周 559 星

分工是两个模型

GPT-6 Astra 当规划者：定当前目标、要拿什么、往哪走
TypeSafe 的 Jev 当控制器：从当前游戏状态里选下一个动作

这一局 Jev 做了 131 次决策，Astra 调用 35 次。最后六张床炸死末影龙，一次落地解决

比上一版录制快了 40%，屠龙那段从 332 秒压到 152 秒

全程没有重开、没有改代码、没有人工接管

这类演示最容易注水，所以作者自己划了几条线

服务端那个读龙头坐标的观测接口是只读的，不发道具、不移动玩家、不改血量、不改龙的 AI
所有动作走正常玩家协议，不改游戏规则
模型拿到的是结构化游戏状态，不是截图也不是逐个按键，寻路交给 Mineflayer
combat-lab 那台测试服可以预置道具，作者写明：测试台结果不算完整生存通关，也绝不能说成模型控制的运行
录制中途如果更新过代码，必须在视频里标出暂停点，不许说成无死亡不间断

顺带一提，这个种子是选过的：有村庄、三个补给箱共 21 个黑曜石、天然已激活的末地传送门。作者也说了，这是一个好用的速通种子，不代表最简单

一个提醒：仓库没有放开源协议，默认版权保留，想拿去改先问作者
items.title: minecraft-agent：Astra 规划 + Jev 控制，选种速通末影龙 8 分 43 秒零死亡
items.summary: 演示里双模型分工：GPT-6 Astra 做规划，TypeSafe 的 Jev 做控制器，从结构化状态选动作；一局 Jev 决策 131 次、Astra 调用 35 次，末地六床炸龙，全程无重开无改码无接管。作者划清边界：龙头坐标观测只读、动作走玩家协议、截图/按键不喂模型，并写明种子偏好与「测试台≠完整生存」；仓库未开源协议需先问作者。
items.recommend_reason: 少见地把通关演示与防注水边界写清楚的 Minecraft Agent 复盘，比纯高光视频更值得存档。

items.author: levie
items.text:
Interesting to think about all the implications in a world where agents begin to make the best or most efficient choice for their users.

On one hand, there is some subset of the economy that benefits from the friction customers traditionally have changing something about their habits. In those parts of the market, switching costs will come down and competition is going to increase dramatically until some equilibrium is reached between the disruptive alternatives and the incumbents.

On the other hand, there are lots of markets that are hurt by a significant amount of friction, where agents will begin to unlock all kinds of economic activity by making it far easier to buy products or services that were too frictionful before. Healthcare, travel, local services, certain information services, and other entirely new markets probably are net beneficiaries of agents as a result.

No matter what, a future meaningfully mediated by agents that work tirelessly for us and our goals can’t possibly function exactly the same as today. Going to be wild.

items.title: Levie：代理替用户做最优选择将压低切换成本，也解锁高摩擦行业需求
items.summary: Box CEO Aaron Levie 讨论代理开始为用户做最高效选择时的经济含义：依赖习惯摩擦的市场切换成本下降、竞争加剧；医疗、旅行、本地服务等信息摩擦高的行业则可能被解锁。无论怎样，由代理深度中介的未来不会与今天相同。
items.recommend_reason: 从切换成本与摩擦行业两侧拆代理经济，比单边「颠覆一切」更完整。

items.author: cline
items.name: Cline
items.text:
Ember-1 by the Fireworks Research team is built on Kimi K3, and uses ~40% fewer tokens while achieving the same performance on benchmarks.

This was accomplished by post-training K3 to think less repetitively.

Reasoning models spend most of their output tokens (sometimes 90%+) on thinking before they answer, which gets expensive in agentic loops where the model tends to re-think the same thoughts on every step.

Fireworks RL trained on real agentic coding task loops to teach the model which reasoning actually changes the answer vs which is just looping.

In a live A/B test on coding traffic, Ember-1 used 71% fewer reasoning tokens and 39% fewer total tokens than K3 at the same success rate.
items.title: Fireworks Ember-1：在 Kimi K3 上后训练少复读，代理循环同成功率下总 token 约少 39%
items.summary: Cline 介绍 Fireworks Research 的 Ember-1：基于 Kimi K3，经 RL 在真实代理编码循环中训练，让模型少做无效重复思考。基准上约少用 40% token 仍保持相近表现；线上 A/B 显示推理 token 少 71%、总 token 少 39%，成功率持平。推理模型输出常有 90%+ 花在思考上，代理每步重想会很贵，此工作针对这一点。
items.recommend_reason: 少见的「推理 token 浪费」产品化数据：同成功率下显著降本，对跑代理循环的人很实用。

items.author: emollick
items.name: Ethan Mollick
items.text: Qualitatively, there is now a larger gap between open & closed models than there has been in awhile. Fable/Astra class models are agentic in a way pre-Fable models are not, for better or worse. None of the open models have crossed that line, yet. When they do, it will be a jump.
items.title: Emollick：开闭源模型质性差距又拉大，Fable/Astra 级代理感是分水岭
items.summary: 他观察开源与闭源模型的质性差距近来又变大：Fable/Astra 级模型具备前代所无的代理感（好坏另说），开源尚未跨过这条线；一旦跨过会是一次跃迁。
items.recommend_reason: 用「是否跨过代理感门槛」描述开闭源差距，比单纯榜单分数更利于判断下一跳。

items.author: brian_armstrong
items.text:
Most companies would move faster if internal platforms had to win their internal customers the same way they win external ones.

Publish your uptime, latency, and cost. Take feature requests in the open. And if you're a real product, it's fine to charge internal teams like any other customer.

Agents make this practical. They can discover services, compare them, and route around the bad ones.
items.title: Armstrong：内部平台也应公开可用性指标并向内部客户收费，代理会绕开差服务
items.summary: 他续论：公司若让内部平台像对外产品一样赢内部客户会更快——公开可用性、延迟与成本，公开收需求，必要时向内部团队收费。代理让这变得现实：它们能发现服务、比较并绕开差的那一侧。
items.recommend_reason: 把平台工程的「内部市场」叙事对齐代理时代的服务发现与路由，和上一则 /feedback 形成配套。

items.author: brian_armstrong
items.text:
Every backend service should have a /feedback endpoint.

Agents are quickly becoming the heaviest users of most APIs. When one hits a missing feature or a bug, it should be able to say so right there, in a structured way. 

If the request makes sense, another agent drafts the PR and a human approves it.  Software that improves itself based on what its users actually tried to do speeds up recursive self improvement.
items.title: Armstrong：后端该有 /feedback，好让代理以结构化方式报缺能力并触发自改进
items.summary: Brian Armstrong 主张每个后端服务提供 /feedback：代理正成为多数 API 的最大用户，撞到缺功能或 bug 时应能当场结构化反馈；合理请求可由另一代理起草 PR、人类审批，让软件按真实用法递归自改进。
items.recommend_reason: 把「代理重度用 API」落到具体接口设计，比空谈自改进更可执行。

items.author: OfficialLoganK
items.text:
2027 is the year we will see at scale autonomous revenue (profit?) generating agents / mini-companies

already happening at sub scale today with lots of rough edges
items.summary: 2027 年我们将看到大规模自主创收（甚至盈利？）的代理 / 迷你公司；如今已在亚规模发生，只是毛边很多。
items.recommend_reason: Logan 对「自主创收代理」时间表的短预测，便于对照今年亚规模实验是否在加厚。

items.author: trq212
items.text: I am most afraid of us eating the productivity gains of agents by just becoming lazier.
items.summary: 我最担心的是：我们把代理带来的生产率增益，又用变懒给吃掉了。
items.recommend_reason: 一句戳中「代理红利被行为抵消」的风险，适合当精选里的清醒剂。

items.author: RookieRicardoR
items.text:
Grok Bot 云主机的各项配置都远远超越 Muse，但是体验没有 Muse 好，我体验下来有两点 Muse 做的很好：

1. Muse 的 Spark 模型智能程度更强，它在 AA Index 是仅次于 Claude 的存在，超越 GPT 和 Grok。

2. Muse 的模型速度很快， 能比较顺畅的沟通，而 Grok Bot 的每次回答起码 5 秒钟，非常难受。 https://t.co/omhGg8unA3
items.title: 实测对比：Grok Bot 云配更高，但 Muse 在智能与响应速度上更顺手
items.summary: 作者称 Grok Bot 云主机配置远超 Muse，体验却不如：一是 Muse Spark 在 AA Index 仅次于 Claude、强过 GPT/Grok；二是 Muse 对话更顺，Grok Bot 每答常要约 5 秒。
items.recommend_reason: 同一批「个人 Agent 主机」用户的横向体感，配置≠体感的对照有参考价值。
